Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
Mata Haro text :

Independent, Red List: Mata Hari has 2 votes (titled). You and she may play
cards that require a sect and/or clan as if she were of that required sect
or clan.

- Can Mata benefit from the "Laibon Ravnos" part of the Eldest are Kholo
(modifier) ?

Eldest text : Only usable during a referendum. [action modifier] Each ready
Laibon Ravnos gets 2 additional votes. [reaction] Each ready Ravnos gets 1
additional vote.

- can Wamukota consider Mata Hari a Laibon and use his special ?

Wamukota, Laibon: If one of your other Laibon is blocked while attemting to
equip, employ or recruit, you may tap Wamukota to cancel the combat (if any)
and have that Laibon continue the action as if unblocked. +1 bleed.

Thanks,

Orpheus

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <4424fd6e$0$27060$626a...@news.free.fr>, Orpheus

<orphe...@DEADSPAMfree.fr> writes:
>Mata Haro text :
>
>Independent, Red List: Mata Hari has 2 votes (titled). You and she may play
>cards that require a sect and/or clan as if she were of that required sect
>or clan.
>
>- Can Mata benefit from the "Laibon Ravnos" part of the Eldest are Kholo
>(modifier) ?

Not if she's not Laibon. It doesn't require Laibon, just Ravnos, so she
can't pretend to be Laibon for the play/resolution of the card.

>- can Wamukota consider Mata Hari a Laibon and use his special ?
>
>Wamukota, Laibon: If one of your other Laibon is blocked while attemting to
>equip, employ or recruit, you may tap Wamukota to cancel the combat (if any)
>and have that Laibon continue the action as if unblocked. +1 bleed.

Only the cards that use Mata Hari's special see her as Laibon for
play/resolve (and not once in play). Everything else sees what she
really is. So Wamukota can't see Mata as a Laibon unless she's Laibon.

See also allies pretending to be vampires. Someone who got a bonus
against vampires wouldn't get it against an ally using a "pretend to be
a vampire for the play of this card" effect.

--
James Coupe
